ranking_by: best official outright water speed record set by each boat
subject: speed record boats
title: The 5 Fastest Boats Ever, Ranked (#1 Was Built at Home)

scenes.text: The fastest boat ever was built in a backyard. Its record has stood since 1978.
Number five: Bluebird K4. A hundred and forty-one miles an hour, back in 1939.
scenes.label: Bluebird K4 · 141 mph

scenes.text: Number four: Slo-mo-shun Four. A hundred and seventy-eight, skimming the lake on just three points.
scenes.label: Slo-mo-shun IV · 178 mph

scenes.text: Number three: Bluebird K7. Two hundred and seventy-six miles an hour, on jet power.
scenes.label: Bluebird K7 · 276 mph

scenes.text: Number two: Hustler. Two hundred and eighty-five miles an hour, set in 1967.
scenes.label: Hustler · 285 mph

scenes.text: Number one: Spirit of Australia. Three hundred and seventeen miles an hour, built by one man at home. Two people have died trying to beat it.
scenes.label: Spirit of Australia · 317 mph

description:
Best official water speed records of the boats that held the outright record: Bluebird K4 141.7 mph (1939), Slo-mo-shun IV 178.5 mph (1952), Bluebird K7 276.3 mph (1964), Hustler 285.2 mph (1967) and Spirit of Australia 317.6 mph, about 511 km/h (1978).
Ken Warby designed and built Spirit of Australia in his backyard in Sydney. Lee Taylor (1980) and Craig Arfons (1989) were killed trying to beat his record.
Would you climb into a boat going 317 mph?
first_comment: The water speed record is one of the deadliest records in sport. Which speed record should we rank next?
